description_en: Creates a flow log with log delivery enabled by default
description_zh: 创建流日志默认开启日志投递
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter create-flow-log --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --instance-type VBR --instance-id vbr-xxx --project-name flowlog-project --log-store-name flowlog-logstore --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The Express Connect Router (ECR) instance ID
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without modifying EPS resources.

false (default): sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the flow log.
The name can be empty or 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志名称。
名称可以为空或长度为 0～128 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the flow log.
The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的描述信息。
描述可以为空或长度为 0～256 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:
VBR: Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VBR：边界路由器实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The VBR instance ID.

The VBR instance must be created by calling the Vpc/2016-04-28 CreateVirtualBorderRouter API operation (which requires a PhysicalConnection as a prerequisite).
The VBR instance must first be mounted to the ECR specified by EcrId by calling AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance, and the mount status must be ACTIVE before you can create a flow log. You can call DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstance to query the mount status of the child instance
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例ID。

VBR实例需通过 Vpc/2016-04-28 CreateVirtualBorderRouter API 创建（前置依赖为 PhysicalConnection 物理专线）。
该VBR实例须先通过AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance挂载为EcrId对应ECR的子实例，且挂载状态为ACTIVE后才能创建流日志。可通过DescribeExpressConnectRouterChildInstance查询子实例挂载状态
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The capture window duration for the flow log to capture traffic. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

60 
600

Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：

60 
600

默认值：600
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The sampling ratio. Valid values:

1:4096
1:2048
1:1024

Default value: 1:4096
parameters.name: sampling_rate

parameters.help_en:
The Project that stores the caught traffic.
If you have already created a Project in the current region, enter the name of the existing Project.
If you have not created a Project in the current region, specify a custom name for the Project. The system automatically creates the Project.


The Project name is globally unique within the Alibaba Cloud region and cannot be modified after creation. The naming rules are as follows:

The Project name must be globally unique.
The name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).
The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
存储捕获流量的 Project。
如果您已经在当前地域创建了 Project，您可以输入已创建的 Project 的名称。
如果您未在当前地域创建 Project，您可以为 Project 自定义名称，系统会帮您自动创建 Project。


Project 名称在阿里云地域内全局唯一，创建后不可修改。其命名规则如下：
   
Project名称必须全局唯一。
只能包括小写
字母、数字和短划线（-）。
必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
长度为 3~63 字符
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The Logstore that stores the caught traffic.
If you have already created a Logstore in the current region, enter the name of the existing Logstore.
If you have not created a Logstore in the current region, specify a custom name for the Logstore. The system automatically creates the Logstore. The naming rules are as follows:

Logstore names must be unique within the same Project.
The name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
存储捕获流量的 Logstore。
如果您已经在当前地域创建了 Logstore，您可以输入已创建的 Logstore 的名称。
如果您未在当前地域创建 Logstore，您可以为 Logstore 自定义名称，系统会帮您自动创建 Logstore。 Logstore 名称。其命名规则如下：

同一个 Project 下，Logstore 名称不可重复。
只能包括小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
长度为 3~63 字符
parameters.name: log_store_name

fields.help_en: The tag key of the resource. Once specified, the value cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:, or contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. Once specified, the value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:, or contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags.

You can bind up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签。

最多可以绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the flow log instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 流日志实例所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region of the Project to which logs are delivered. Specify this parameter only for cross-region log delivery. This parameter is not required for same-region log delivery
parameters.help_zh: 当前字段代表需要投递的project所属region信息，仅跨地域投递需要填写该字段，  非跨地域投递不需要填写该字段
parameters.name: target_sls_region_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. For more information about error codes, see error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace the %s in the ErrMessage return parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the request parameter DtsJobId is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则表示所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

True: successful.
False: failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
